SummaryInformation.Definition: A rare, soft tissue tumor characterized by high incidence of local recurrence, regional lymph node involvement and distant metastases. It commonly affects the soft tissue under the skin of a finger, hand, forearm, lower leg or foot, less often other areas of the body.
